exceptions.reason: The post-action freshness regressions read markers, settlement proofs and seeded balance snapshots back out of the query cache immediately after the writer under test runs; each read is asserted in the same test.
Six restored-marker cases build the persisted owner-state shapes the restore parser must accept or reject, which the parser's generic input type cannot express.
The Playwright fixed-date shim advances the pinned page clock by real elapsed time across reloads, so it reads the native clock once through a helper.
The host story injects a partial AccountWalletClient whose fetchAccountResource serves the cards and activity-orders fixtures; constructing the full client would add harness noise.
Intentionally malformed SDK return fixture exercises rejection of a non-string token the SDK type forbids.
